describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing lateral view with a low, elongated body supported by four short limbs. The head is broad, flattened and pale pink with smooth, slightly glossy skin, a blunt snout, small nostrils at the tip, and large round dark eyes on the sides. Immediately behind the head on each side of the neck are three feathery, pinkish-red external gills with fine filamentous branches. The entire dorsal surface from the neck to the base of the tail is covered by a continuous armor of overlapping large rounded brown scales with darker centers and lighter edges. The ventral, lateral, and limb skin is pale pink, hairless and deeply wrinkled with transverse folds along the flanks and limbs. The limbs are thick and end in broad five-toed feet with small claws. A thick, wrinkled pale pink tail extends posteriorly from the body, partially cropped by the left edge of the image and partially covered dorsally by the scaly armor.

describe.description: The creature is a quadruped shown in right-facing profile with a pale pink, wrinkled, hairless underside and limbs and a broad smooth flat-snouted head. Behind the head are multiple pink feathery branched external gills. The entire back from the neck to the rear is covered in large overlapping dark brown rounded scales, with the scaly tail extending out of frame to the left. It has four short thick wrinkled legs ending in broad five-toed feet with small pale claws, and large round dark eyes on the sides of the head with a slight closed-mouth smile.
